mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 5%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances following a 3-month INDPRO decline, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500,000 in a month, indicating strong real estate activity, correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to broadening economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances with RSAFS growth above $500,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the current low FEDFUNDS rate (below 1%) maintains a supportive monetary environment, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high PAYEMS (above 130,000) and low UNRATE (below 6%) indicates a labor market at full capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to inflation concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances with PAYEMS above 130,000 and UNRATE below 6%, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling growing housing demand, is followed by positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as housing is a leading indicator of broader economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of months with HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window.
